agreements: Gearbox v1 verified baseline and Step009 Heartbeat verified foundation remain preserved; this review changes no formal state and claims no C PASS.
Heartbeat, poll, retry, reconnect, wait, scheduler wake, window age and uptime are zero Experience.

Under v2.1, DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND are intended to be operational progress only and must not become verified Experience, P_base, Trust, Identity, Personality or Governance evidence.

v2.1 strict-bool checks for secretary_signal_fresh, authority_conflict and direct event_independently_verified are valid local hardening, but they do not establish provenance, freshness or verifier authority.
verified_progress_density is currently reason-only; keeping it observational is acceptable until independently derived and adversarially validated.
GEARBOX_V2_1_CONTRACT correctly labels speedup as NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED and v2 pressure as an engineering heuristic.
formal_mutation_allowed remains false and P_base remains read-only.

disagreements.finding: New material delta for the latest-only receipt: Gearbox v2 still assigns positive EXPERIENCE_WEIGHTS to DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND and exposes them through a field named experience_candidate_delta. Gearbox v2.1 contract, by contrast, requires these same events to be operational progress only. Because select_gear_v2 remains a public callable path and v2.1 inherits v2 rather than replacing its semantic boundary, a legacy/live caller can consume v2 directly and misclassify operational work as Experience Candidate without violating any current v2 test.
disagreements.required_change: Unify the semantic boundary across v2 and v2.1: authoritative interfaces must expose separate verified_experience_delta and operational_progress_delta from one shared classifier. DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND must never appear in an authoritative Experience-labelled field. If v2 compatibility must remain, mark its experience_candidate_delta non-authoritative/research-only and prohibit it from live Experience accounting or promotion evidence.

disagreements.finding: aggregate_experience_events accepts DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND as operational_progress from only caller-supplied event_id + event_kind; no durable artifact hash, defect/evidence hash, acceptance receipt, source identity or mission/scope binding is required.
disagreements.required_change: Require canonical durable-progress/defect evidence identity plus immutable operational acceptance receipt before nonzero operational credit; unsupported caller-only operational claims receive zero credit.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh and authority_conflict remain caller declarations. Strict bool proves type only, not source, timestamp/TTL, policy, revocation or installation/runtime binding.
disagreements.required_change: Use typed SecretarySignalEnvelope and AuthorityDecisionEnvelope bound to exact source, scope, freshness, policy and runtime/install identity.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict only neutralizes secretary_level; it does not load or enforce the actual fresh authority decision.
disagreements.required_change: Consume the exact trusted authority decision/snapshot; stale, revoked, cross-mission or cross-install evidence fails closed.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller supplied and thresholded at >=0.50 without canonical numerator/denominator, minimum support, observation window, uncertainty or stateful enter/exit hysteresis.
disagreements.required_change: Derive shift rate from canonical append-only shift history with preregistered support/window/uncertainty and bounded hysteretic release.

disagreements.finding: Anti-thrash can lower gear_shift_rate while delaying necessary safe upshift and worsening cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure throughput or recovery_latency.
disagreements.required_change: Require paired performance non-regression and bounded release/cooldown; fewer shifts alone is not improvement.

disagreements.finding: Verified Experience still requires only an event kind plus a boolean; exact evidence hash, verifier identity and trusted C/independent-verifier receipt are not required.
disagreements.required_change: Require immutable evidence identity plus trusted verifier receipt bound to mission/step/scope, freshness/revocation and installation/workspace identity.

disagreements.finding: event_id dedupe exists only within one aggregate invocation; same evidence under new IDs, cross-run/restart/rollback/poll replay and same-ID rebinding can be re-credited.
disagreements.required_change: Use a durable rollback-resistant event/evidence-lineage acceptance registry with exact replay=no-op, same-evidence/new-ID=lineage duplicate and same-ID/different-binding=IDENTITY_CONFLICT.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 recomputes verified and operational deltas directly from caller event fields, bypassing aggregate_experience_events and any future durable-ledger repair.
disagreements.required_change: Both credit classes must come from one immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt; receipt-less decision calls emit zero credit.

disagreements.finding: aggregate_experience_events calls strict verification parsing before canonical record eligibility/identity is safely isolated, so a malformed row can abort a batch and suppress later valid evidence.
disagreements.required_change: Validate record shape/identity first; bounded non-atomic ingestion rejects/quarantines malformed rows independently without poisoning identity or blocking later valid records.

disagreements.finding: v1 supports N standby and R rollback; v2 can inherit those values, but v2.1 unconditionally executes int(selected[1:]), so canonical N/R safety paths can raise ValueError.
disagreements.required_change: Handle N/R as terminal control states before G-gear numeric parsing; anti-thrash must never delay rollback or standby semantics.

disagreements.finding: 5/4/3 verified credits and operational 1 are engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability units.
disagreements.required_change: Never interpret aggregate credit as capability truth, Trust, Identity/Personality evidence or promotion threshold.

disagreements.finding: No executable matched paired-baseline protocol establishes speedup; commit count, wake count or awake time are invalid substitutes.
disagreements.required_change: Use sealed matched workloads and paired/crossover baselines over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with frozen denominator/exposure/censoring/order, full assigned-workload coverage, uncertainty and verification/risk non-regression.

statistical_risks: Operational-vs-Experience semantics differ between public v2 and v2.1 interfaces; mixed consumers can create incomparable longitudinal metrics and false learning claims.
Unbound operational events allow numerator inflation in durable_progress_per_wake without a corresponding durable artifact or verified closure.
Caller-declared freshness or authority conflict invalidates causal routing comparisons.
Small-n shift-rate estimates have extreme variance and can false-trigger or chatter around a single threshold.
Anti-thrash can improve gear_shift_rate while worsening cycle/closure/recovery latency.
verified_progress_density becomes self-reinforcing if later wired from policy-created progress back into upshift decisions.
Transient event identity plus direct decision-path credit can inflate longitudinal verified/operational totals.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.

durable_progress_per_wake is denominator- and numerator-provenance-sensitive; verified_closure_per_hour is exposure/censoring-sensitive; fixed treatment order and completed-only analysis create carryover and survivorship bias.
proposed_tests: GB21-V2-OPERATIONAL-SEMANTIC-077: call public select_gear_v2/experience_candidate_delta with DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND; authoritative Experience-labelled output must be zero or explicitly non-authoritative, while operational credit remains separately projected.

GB21-V2-V21-CLASSIFIER-CONSISTENCY-078: every event kind must produce the same verified-vs-operational classification across the shared v2/v2.1 authoritative classifier; any compatibility field cannot be consumed as promotion/Experience evidence.
GB21-OPERATIONAL-EVIDENCE-074 + GB21-OPERATIONAL-LINEAGE-075 + GB21-SPEED-NUMERATOR-BINDING-076: operational credit requires evidence-bound exactly-once acceptance and speed numerator binding.
GB21-AUTHORITY-DECISION-PROJECTION-028: trusted authority=G1/recovery projects G1 even when fallback caller kwargs are permissive.
GB21-SHIFT-RATE-PROVENANCE-017 + SHIFT-SMALL-N-004 + ANTI-THRASH-CHATTER-040 + RELEASE-041: canonical shift ledger, adequate support, uncertainty and bounded release are required.
GB21-PROGRESS-DENSITY-FORGE-007: verified_progress_density=1 alone has zero routing/Experience/promotion/authority effect.
GB21-CROSS-RUN-SAME-ID-018 + ROLLBACK-LEDGER-019 + POLL-REPLAY-020 + EVENT-REBIND-021: durable exactly-once and identity-conflict semantics survive restart, rollback and polling.
GB21-VERIFIER-EVIDENCE-011: verified kind without exact evidence hash plus trusted verifier/C receipt gets zero credit.
GB21-DIRECT-CREDIT-BYPASS-022 + OPERATIONAL-CREDIT-BYPASS-024: every nonzero credit is tied to one immutable accepted receipt.
GB21-MALFORMED-BATCH-ISOLATION-072 + GB21-NR-STATE-069 + GB21-ROLLBACK-STATE-070: malformed batch rows are isolated and N/R safety states are terminal/non-crashing.
GB21-CREDIT-SCORE-014: equal aggregate scores from different event mixes cannot imply equivalent capability or trigger promotion.

GB21-PAIRED-SPEED-015 + WAKE-DENOMINATOR-FREEZE-030 + TIME-WINDOW-FREEZE-032 + ORDER-CROSSOVER-036 + ITT-WORKLOAD-COVERAGE-038: speedup requires matched workload, frozen denominator/exposure policy, crossover/order control, full assigned-workload coverage and uncertainty/non-regression.
release_condition: No formal adoption or speedup claim from this research review alone.
Authoritative v2/v2.1 event semantics must be unified: DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND are operational-only everywhere and can never appear as authoritative Experience-labelled credit.

Operational progress must be evidence-bound and exactly-once/lineage-bound; unsupported caller-only operational claims get zero credit and speed numerators derive only from immutable operational acceptance receipts.
Secretary freshness/provenance must be evidence-bound; fresh authority must be projected from an exact trusted decision, not a caller boolean.
Anti-thrash inputs must be canonically derived with adequate sample support, uncertainty and hysteretic release; cycle/closure/recovery performance must be non-inferior.
verified_progress_density remains observational until independently derived and tested against feedback/self-reinforcement.
All verified Experience requires exact evidence identity plus trusted C/independent-verifier receipt.
Experience/operational credit must be exactly-once and lineage-bound across restart/rollback/poll/replay; decision paths consume immutable acceptance receipts only.
Malformed records must be isolated without poisoning later valid evidence, and N/R safety states must be terminal/non-crashing before G-gear parsing.
5/4/3/1 weights remain heuristic and cannot be capability/Trust/Identity/Personality/promotion truth.

Any speedup claim requires a sealed matched-workload paired/crossover baseline using durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with frozen numerator/denominator provenance, exposure/censoring, order, full assigned-workload coverage, uncertainty and verification/risk non-regression.
Heartbeat/poll/retry/reconnect/wait/scheduler wake/window age remain zero Experience; P_base remains read-only; v1 verified baseline remains preserved.
